ns2:section.sectionText: This is a fast-paced, fully online course taught in the Moodle course management system with no face-to-face classroom sessions. All assessments will be conducted online. Weekly, one-hour exams will be administered online between 2 and 7 p.m. Fridays. The last exam will be administered online 8 am. - noon, August 2. There are interactive assignments and projects with weekly deadlines. Further information including a syllabus and grading policy at http://www.life.illinois.edu/ib/105/summer/online/index.html
